name: tldv
description: Access Google Meet, Zoom & Teams meeting transcripts. Yours, and those from your team & company.

_published_faq.name: How do I add tldv to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add tldv to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tldv.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the tldv MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: tldv provides these MCP tools: get-meeting-metadata, get-meeting-notes, get-meeting-transcript, get-user-profile, and search-meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to tldv?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to tldv in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
tldv requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
tldv is developed by tldx solutions GmbH. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
